newsitem.title: USA: NRG Generating to trade on Nasdaq SmallCap.
newsitem.headline: NRG Generating to trade on Nasdaq SmallCap.

text.p: NRG Generating (U.S.) Inc said Thursday its shares will begin trading on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market during the week of March 10.
The company announced in November it had applied to have its common shares listed by Nasdaq.
NRG Generating develops and owns cogeneration projects that produce electricity and thermal energy for sale to commercial and industrial users in addition to public utilities.
It is 41.86-percent owned by NRG Energy Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of Northern States Power Co.
